reviews.text: Incredibly warm and welcoming vets. My cat had to have an emergency appointment and unfortunately had to be euthanized, and it was met with empathy for both us and the animal, and we got plenty of time with the cat before it had to happen. The vet was very good at explaining everything in the process in detail, which I really appreciated. Highly recommended if you want your animal and you to be well taken care of :)
Always good and fast service. This time I only needed one prescription, but then I only got one for pickup, always more for previous prescriptions, still at a relatively high price.
Incompetent veterinarians made me and my family waste money on unnecessary medicine that didn't work and ultimately killed my parrot.

I was charged 1909 NOK for a 30-minute consultation, which is more than double what I have previously paid for the same type of service. Consultation itself did not feel substantially different or more thorough to justify such a price.
Fantastic service! Very satisfied after a visit here with the lady. Skilled people who explain well and no surprising costs.
Nice and smart people, I always feel welcome and that I am taken seriously

My beloved dog Galahad, an English Cocker Spaniel, 14 years and 9 months, became noticeably weaker in a short time. At the female veterinarian, the dog received very good care and follow-up during the almost 2-hour visit that ended with a dignified end for the dog. I am very grateful to the clinic.

Very nice staff, and high professional competence. They give honest answers to questions and are genuinely concerned about what is best for the animals.
There are also opening hours that make it easy to book an appointment.
Nice staff and veterinarian☺️

Ok clinic and service, the vet was nice and gentle with my dog. But I was disappointed they didn't have proper dog snacks or water to offer in the waiting room to the dogs. It is important dogs are rewarded for tolerating their treatment and have overall a good experience.
Female vet who showed care and understanding in a difficult decision ❤️
Very friendly staff, short waiting time, and they handled my anxious cat wonderfully. I can highly recommend them!
very happy
Very good service and very attentive staff
Nice welcome to help :-)
Mochi loves her vet! 😁 Awesome staff, nice, modern & clean facilities. …
Was well received and came in ahead of time. Good and calm veterinarian.
Very satisfied, quiet and peaceful place for dogs, recommend!
Very nice and attentive vets. They take very good care of my diabetic cat.
Nice and talented people, but in the morning they are more professional than late at night 😉 …

Fantastic!! Was greeted by a gentle and welcoming vet who took the time to thoroughly examine her. My dog ​​left very happy, with a bag of diet food and a couple of shorter claws. Felt safe and well taken care of from start to finish. Thank you for a great first meeting, we will happily come here again😃 …

Hello. I wanted to buy a flea collar for my cat, and the lady behind the counter told me I had to subscribe for 1,000 NOK before purchasing. It seems like a small thing; a collar for a cat, and someone is trying to lure you into a financial trap. I don't recommend it.
Nice, clean and neat place.

Disappointed about the doctor’s knowledge. We went to see if the dog has all the vaccines for travel and they told yes, he is safe to travel. Later from another vet we found out he didn’t even had vaccine for rabies(most important for travelling to our destination) and another vaccine had ended 2 months before. How can a doctor say everything is fine when nothing was and take so much money for exactly nothing.
